title: Wendell and the Ghost
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Casper Dunmore, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
